name: Claire Chase: Love ⚡︎ Struck
source:
Claire Chase is a student at Granfors University, a lead institution on criminial science related courses. One rainy afternoon she stumbles into a café with dubious reputation, a potential love interest and as always, a crime soon to happen that will change her life forever! Or for the foreseable future, at least.

[From [url=https://monochrome.itch.io/cc-lovestruck]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
克莱尔·蔡斯 (Claire Chase) 是格兰福斯大学 (Granfors University) 的学生，该大学是犯罪科学相关课程的领先机构。一个下雨的下午，她无意中走进了一家声誉可疑的咖啡馆，她有一个潜在的爱情对象，而且一如既往，一场即将发生的犯罪事件将永远改变她的生活！或者至少在可预见的未来。

[来自[url=https://monochrome.itch.io/cc-lovestruck]Itch.io[/url]]
